verdict.rationale: Cross-calendar busy-block syncing is a fair question for a scheduling tool, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only that SavvyCal checks multiple connected calendars for conflicts when offering booking times. It never shows SavvyCal writing busy blocks from one calendar into another to keep work and personal schedules in step. Conflict-checking is an adjacent feature, not the story's capability.

support.subject: As a knowledge worker, busy blocks sync between my work and personal calendars automatically so all my schedules stay in step
